title: Graduate at UCLA Royce Hall, Family On Steps - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A proud female college graduate in her cap and gown holds her diploma or scroll while surrounded by smiling family members on the steps outside a grand Romanesque Revival loggia, characteristic of Royce Hall at UCLA. The family wears stylish mid-1960s outerwear, including tailored overcoats, a trench coat, and formal daywear. The photograph captures an uplifting milestone during the mid-century expansion of American higher education.
